hints.title: Pair off different values
hints.body: Whenever two different values meet, they can cancel each other out.

hints.title: Keep a candidate
hints.body: Track one candidate and a count. Matching values increase the count; different values decrease it.

hints.title: Count zero means replace
hints.body: When the count reaches zero, adopt the current value as the new candidate.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
candidate = nums[0]
count = 0
for value in nums:
    if count == 0:
        candidate = value
    count += 1 if value == candidate else -1
return candidate
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
